description: Recommend local-AI setups for a given hardware: platform + device count, optional goal (quality | balance | speed). Returns the editorial picks for that setup first (with the reason and the recipe's numbers), then all matching recipes by rank (category → value) or by AA intelligence. Every number has category, condition and source_url.

goal.description: Optional: only picks for this goal

limit.description: Max recipes after the picks (default 20, max 100)

locale.description: Page locale for returned URLs (default en)

name: find_local_ai_recipes

count.description: Number of returned records for list and search tools.

data.description: Structured result payload. Present for responseFormat='v2' tools.

error.description: Human-readable error message when success is false.

meta.description: Result metadata such as count, locale fallback, cache scope, or response format.

success.description: Whether the tool call completed successfully.

title: Find Local AI Recipes for Hardware
